counting_policy: Authoritative named archives, technical-report systems, standards collections, and engineering databases are source resources; individual reports, standards, datasets, or models count separately only after record-level verification.

resources.title: NASA Technical Reports Server
resources.storage_policy: metadata_and_links; individual reports checked for public availability and rights before local ingestion

resources.title: NASA Technical Standards System
resources.storage_policy: discovery_connector; individual standards verified and cataloged by document number/version/access status

resources.title: NASA Airfoil and Aerodynamics Technical Resources via NTRS
resources.storage_policy: search/reference connector; individual aerodynamic reports and datasets require record-level verification

resources.title: FAA Lessons Learned from Transport Airplane Accidents
NASA Planetary Data System
resources.storage_policy: metadata_and_public_data; preserve mission/instrument/product identifiers and archive provenance

resources.title: NASA NAIF SPICE Toolkit and Data
resources.provider: NASA Navigation and Ancillary Information Facility
resources.storage_policy: software_and_metadata; preserve toolkit/kernel versions and mission provenance

resources.title: General Mission Analysis Tool (GMAT)
resources.storage_policy: software/reference; preserve NASA software release/license/version provenance

resources.title: NASA Software Catalog
resources.storage_policy: discovery_connector; each software package requires release/license/access verification before counting individually
